ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows a parallelogram labeled TUVW. Vertex T is at the lower left, U at the upper left, V at the upper right, and W at the lower right. The angle at T is labeled x°, the angle at U is labeled (3x−4)°, the angle at V is labeled x°, and the angle at W is labeled (3x−4)°. Reasoning: In a parallelogram, consecutive interior angles are supplementary. Using angles T and U: x + (3x−4) = 180. Then 4x−4 = 180, so 4x = 184, and x = 46. Since angle V is labeled x°, angle V = 46°.
